verdict.line: You win when you punish a used Q or W with your E-Q stun chain; you lose if you walk into a full Ki Burst into Broken Wings combo or let her stack Runic Blade charges for free.

brief.thesis: The numbers say Irelia holds both lane advantage and the solo-kill edge here (334 games), but the 46.4% head-to-head win rate sits well below Irelia's 50.2% overall top-lane baseline. That gap is Riven's cooldown-gated all-in: when Ki Burst and Broken Wings are both up she can stun-lock and dash-knockback you before your passive attack speed ever ramps, but the instant either is down she has no stun and no gap-closer, which is exactly when your Flawless Duet into Bladesurge chain should land.

theirWindow.when: Both Q and W are up
theirWindow.what: This is her full combo: W (Ki Burst) stuns, then Q (Broken Wings) chains three dashes with the third knocking you back. Do not extend trades or chase into this window — hold W (Defiant Dance) to eat the physical damage instead of engaging.

yourWindow.when: She's just used Q or W
yourWindow.what: No stun means your E (Flawless Duet) lands clean for the mark and stun; Bladesurge (Q) onto the marked target refreshes its cooldown so you can dash again or disengage. This is the window OP.GG's own data flags — engage while her kit is down.

start.why: The 90.4%-pick standard start (48.6% WR over 356 games) — the AD and sustain let you contest early Q (Bladesurge) trades without losing the HP war to Riven's autos.

boots.why: 86.4% pick, 46.1% WR — Riven's damage is entirely physical (autos, Q, empowered Runic Blade hits), so the flat reduction directly blunts her all-in.

core.why: On-hit and the active slow stack with Ionian Fervor's attack speed ramp, letting you win extended trades once your passive is maxed out.
Highest-pick core follow-up (30.6% pick, 57% WR alongside Death's Dance) — scales your split-push and skirmish damage as fights drag past level 9.
Bleeds and delays Riven's burst damage, which matters directly against her Ki Burst stun into empowered auto combo.

situational.when: she is building lifesteal or you need more sustained-fight attack speed (61.8% WR path swaps this in for Death's Dance)
you want a more attack-speed-first spike over Hullbreaker's tankiness
she is snowballing kills and you need to remove the fear of her all-in commitment

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through your E-Q-auto trade pattern and rewards the extended fights your passive attack speed ramp wants to force.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the run of choice (47.9% WR, 68% pick) and converts your solo-kill advantage into an actual kill when you catch her on cooldown. Exhaust+Flash (44.4% WR, 28.1% pick) is the safer alternative if you'd rather neutralize her Q3 knockback all-in than close it out.

playing.title: Track her Ki Burst before committing
playing.detail: W (Ki Burst) is her only stun (11/10/9/8/7s cooldown). If it's on cooldown, she cannot lock you down for the Q chain — this is your green light to engage per the OP.GG read on this matchup.

playing.title: Charge W into her physical damage
playing.detail: Defiant Dance takes reduced physical damage while charging, which directly counters her auto-attacks and Q strikes. Charge it during her Broken Wings dashes rather than sidestepping.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for the refresh
playing.detail: Flawless Duet stuns and marks; Bladesurge onto a marked target refreshes its own cooldown, letting you dash again immediately for extra damage or to disengage from her E (Valor) block.

playing.title: Respect a banked Q3 knockback
playing.detail: If she hasn't used all three Broken Wings reactivations, the third strike knocks back — don't chase past that threshold or you'll eat the reset for free.

playing.title: Watch for empowered autos after her abilities
playing.detail: Runic Blade charges her blade off ability casts; an auto immediately following her Q, W, or E hits harder. Don't trade autos blind right after she's cast something.

playing.title: Play safe on the level 6 flip
playing.detail: Her Blade of the Exile grants AD, range, and a one-time Wind Slash — this is the one window in the curve where her all-in outscales yours, so avoid overextending right as both of you hit six.

playing.title: Force fights once BORK and Hullbreaker land
playing.detail: From level 9-13 your on-hit and attack speed stacking outpace her damage in a straight fight — this is where the matchup's kill advantage actually shows up on the scoreboard.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade calls are my own read of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Engage while keeping an eye out on Riven’s Conqueror stacks. Engage when Riven’s skills are on cooldown by using [P] to your advantage.
